title: Shueisha Launches Manga Million Digital Platform Worldwide With Titles in 100+ Languages
content: Shueisha announced on Thursday it has launched its global digital manga platform Manga Million in over 100 languages including English, Chinese, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, French, Turkish, Tagalog, Korean, Polish, and others. The platform has over one million pages of translated manga from 400 titles at launch.
author: ANN

title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered Anime Reveals 3 New Cast Members
content: The staff for the anime of Kentarou 's From Overshadowed to Overpowered ( Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musō: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Bōkenroku ;or The Failed Sage's Academy Domination ) manga revealed three new cast members for characters who will appear in the anime's seventh episode on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) television anime announced an additional pair of cast on Thursday. The new TV anime premiered on Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates.

title: Ninja Scroll 4K Trailer Showcases Yoshiyaki Kawajiri's Hand-Drawn Action Ahead of Revival Screenings
content: The upcoming 4K re-release of Ninja Scroll ( Jubei Ninpucho ) has revealed its official trailer, giving a new look at Yoshiyaki Kawajiri’s 1993 anime film ahead of its limited theatrical return in Japan this September.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll’s Beloved Fantasy Creator’s Underrated Series Confirms a New Anime
content: 2026 has been another incredible year for anime fans with more sequels, debuts, and announcements than ever. As always, Crunchyroll remains the largest streaming hub for fans with several exciting anime series and films across all genres.
author: ComicBook

title: 11 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Beloved Drama Finally Gets The Update Fans Were Waiting For
content: One of the most beloved yet underrated anime series on Crunchyroll , Sound! Euphonium released its anime adaptation in April 2015. The series is based on a novel series written by Ayano Takeda and debuted in 2013.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Drops New Look At The Strongest Sorcerers Ahead of Its Biggest Event
content: Even two years after the main story’s conclusion, Jujutsu Kaisen remains one of the hottest Shonen Jump series. Part of the reason why the fan base is so active is that the franchise keeps returning with new updates and releases. This also includes the anime series since it has yet to fully adapt the story.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling Returns With a New Story Ahead of New Movie
content: The wait for Solo Leveling Season 3 is longer than ever as the animation studio remains silent on the highly anticipated sequel. The second season of the anime reached its conclusion last year, but the anime hasn’t been officially renewed for a third season.
author: ComicBook
